query: Our checkout change spans the web app, pricing service, event schema, analytics consumers, and rollout config. Break the work into dependency waves, assign specialist owners, and leave a checkpoint for tomorrow's agent.
Coordinate an API migration where research must verify a vendor contract, the spec team decides compatibility, backend and mobile can work in parallel, and review needs evidence from both.
This production bug crosses a route, queue, worker, database transaction, feature flag, and alert. I want diagnosis delegated to the debugging skill and the eventual fix gated on evidence.
Plan a resumable refactor of the auth boundary across four packages. Show which tasks can run together, which artifacts feed the next stage, and how to verify fan-in.
We have three agents updating backend, frontend, and contract tests around the same schema. Prevent overlapping edits and keep one source of truth for unresolved decisions.
Map the work for splitting a monolith module: architecture decision first, two independent migrations next, then integration verification and code review. It may take several sessions.
Before implementing this shared SDK change, coordinate impact analysis for twelve consumers, collect evidence from owners, and unlock rollout work only after compatibility gates pass.
Need a work graph, artifact provenance, and verification gates for an incident follow-up involving code, runbooks, monitoring, security review, and deployment changes.
Our data migration has discovery, schema design, backfill, dual-write, validation, and cutover nodes with approval and rollback dependencies. Make it recoverable if the agent session ends.
Review this cross-repo platform proposal by coordinating research, domain modeling, prototype evidence, and final review; each specialist should keep ownership of its conclusion.
Research the latest PostgreSQL logical replication documentation and write a cited Markdown summary in the repo.
Diagnose why this one unit test throws TypeError in user_mapper.ts. Reproduce it and identify the root cause.
Review the changes on this branch against the issue and our coding standards, then report findings by severity.
Write acceptance criteria for adding a required phone number field to the signup form.
Rename the private parseDate helper in one file and update its focused test.
Use TDD to add validation for negative invoice amounts in this existing function.
Explain the call graph shown in this diagram in plain language; do not change or plan anything.
Create an ADR choosing between two cache libraries for this single module.
Resolve the current merge conflict in package-lock.json and run the existing verification command.
Refactor this 25-line function for readability without changing behavior; all callers are in the same file.
